## Shared scenes

> [The Blythe](../codex/factions.md#blythes) children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) for an evening picnic. [Jem](../character/jem.md) cooks trout he caught in the brook while Walter, [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), and Di talk, before they set up their makeshift table for their meal.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P4](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER III. THE INGLESIDE CHILDREN P7](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0007), [v5 CHAPTER III. > [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) settles into life at the manse, attending church in borrowed clothes and taking over housecleaning while refusing to return to school. She forms a bond with the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), fascinating them with ghost stories and feats while clashing occasionally with [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Faith](../character/faith.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P8](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P19](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0019), [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030)_

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary Vance's situation, revealing that her abusive former guardian has died. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where Walter reads mythic stories aloud and speaks solemnly about following the [Pied Piper](../character/pied-piper.md). [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, prompting Mary to express both relief and anxiety over her uncertain future.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. > [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) informs the Meredith and [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children that [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) have caused a scandal by accidentally doing house cleaning on Sunday, having lost track of the days. After realizing their mistake with the day of the week, the group talks about their ideas of heaven before heading home, with [Faith](../character/faith.md) reassuring [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she has a plan to make things right.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P0](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XI. A DREADFUL DISCOVERY P10](../source/v05-c11.md#nw-v05-c11-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XI. > [Faith](../character/faith.md) walks with [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) and hears about his toothache before encountering [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md), who hurls insults at her. She then visits [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md) to urge him to return to church and support the minister's salary. After initially fleeing his fierce reaction, [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns in anger to confront him, which amuses Douglas enough to apologize and accept her bargain.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P23](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0023), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P53](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0053)_

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P11](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P42](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0042), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P63](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0063)_

> The children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to read and talk about their future plans. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) arrives thoroughly startled and tells them the story of Henry Warren's ghost haunting the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden. After cooking and eating dinner together, the children disperse, with the [Merediths](../codex/factions.md#merediths) nervously heading home alone while avoiding the haunted garden.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P1](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009), [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P14](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0014)_

> In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.
>
